answer: What survives to the timber is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Every claim climbs the orchard of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the whisper re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on invitation quota tree, taxed when attestations come from one subnet. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
